name: nextTokenWithPredefinedNextToken
expected: Returns START_OBJECT, clears _nextToken, updates _currToken, and creates a child object context in _parsingContext.

name: nextTokenXmlStartElementLeaf
input: Stream returns XML_START_ELEMENT, _mayBeLeaf is false, not in array
expected: Sets _mayBeLeaf to true, sets current name in parsing context, and returns JsonToken.FIELD_NAME.

name: nextTokenXmlStartElementInArray
expected: Skips/advances underlying stream, sets _mayBeLeaf = true, and loops to process the next token.

name: nextTokenXmlStartElementWithMayBeLeaf
expected: Queues FIELD_NAME in _nextToken, creates child object context, and returns START_OBJECT.

name: nextTokenXmlStartElementWithVirtualWrapping
input: Stream returns XML_START_ELEMENT, local name matches _namesToWrap
expected: Calls _xmlTokens.repeatStartElement(), sets _mayBeLeaf to true, and returns JsonToken.FIELD_NAME.

name: nextTokenXmlEndElementLeafNull
input: Stream returns XML_END_ELEMENT, _mayBeLeaf is true, not in array
expected: Sets _mayBeLeaf to false and returns JsonToken.VALUE_NULL.

name: nextTokenXmlEndElementLeafInArray
input: Stream returns XML_END_ELEMENT, _mayBeLeaf is true, _parsingContext.inArray() is true
expected: Sets _mayBeLeaf to false, queues END_OBJECT in _nextToken, creates child object context, and returns START_OBJECT.

name: nextTokenXmlEndElementNormalObject
input: Stream returns XML_END_ELEMENT, _mayBeLeaf is false, in object context
expected: Returns END_OBJECT, pops parent context, and updates _namesToWrap.

name: nextTokenXmlEndElementNormalArray
input: Stream returns XML_END_ELEMENT, _mayBeLeaf is false, in array context
expected: Returns END_ARRAY, pops parent context, and updates _namesToWrap.

name: nextTokenXmlAttributeNameWithMayBeLeaf
expected: Sets _mayBeLeaf to false, queues FIELD_NAME in _nextToken, caches text, creates child object context, and returns START_OBJECT.

name: nextTokenXmlAttributeNameNormal
expected: Sets current name in parsing context from local name and returns JsonToken.FIELD_NAME.

name: nextTokenXmlAttributeValue
expected: Caches text in _currText and returns JsonToken.VALUE_STRING.

name: nextTokenXmlTextLeafValidString
input: Stream returns XML_TEXT, _mayBeLeaf is true, text is non-empty
expected: Caches text, sets _mayBeLeaf to false, skips end element, and returns JsonToken.VALUE_STRING.

name: nextTokenXmlTextLeafEmptyInArray
input: Stream returns XML_TEXT, _mayBeLeaf is true, in array, text is empty/whitespace
expected: Caches text, sets _mayBeLeaf to false, skips end element, queues END_OBJECT, creates child object context, and returns START_OBJECT.

name: nextTokenXmlTextNonLeafEmptyInObject
input: Stream returns XML_TEXT, _mayBeLeaf is false, in object, text is empty, _currToken != FIELD_NAME
expected: Returns END_OBJECT, pops parent context, and updates _namesToWrap.

name: nextTokenXmlTextNonLeafValidString
input: Stream returns XML_TEXT, _mayBeLeaf is false, text is non-empty
expected: Caches text, sets current name to text element name config, queues VALUE_STRING, and returns JsonToken.FIELD_NAME.

name: nextTokenXmlEnd
expected: Sets _currToken to null and returns null.
